0.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_000
0.description: I have devoted my life to treasures that glitter and gleam. If you would have crystals that truly shine, you know what I require.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_010
6.description: Ah, so the rumors were true. You possess a Zodiac Weapon? Never in all my years have I had the privilege of working with something so precious.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_010
7.description: Fueled by countless souls, and shaped by the strength of your own, it will make a fine pair of astral and umbral nodules.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_011
8.description: However I must warn you: this process will consume the Zodiac Weapon completely, both body and soul. You will have your crystals, but this will mark the end of your weapon and its legendary tale.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_012
9.description: Please be warned that your Zodiac Weapon will be lost should you choose to proceed.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_013
10.description: What's this? So the rumors are simply that: rumors? What a pity.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_020
15.description: Your resolve is admirable. Now, if you could just remove the weapon from your person, I can get to work on the nodules.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_021
16.description: Your resolve is admirable. Now, if you could just remove the sword and shield from your person, I can get to work on the nodules.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_022
17.description: Please ensure that the Zodiac Weapon Zeta you wish to offer is in your Armoury Chest or inventory before speaking with Syndony.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_Q3_000_000
18.description: Offer Syndony <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> to create the astral and umbral nodules?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※<hex:022B12FF1002310CFF054974656D03E80202020303> will be lost.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_Q4_100_001
22.description: Please be warned that this process is irreversible and the Zodiac Weapon Zeta will be permanently lost. Proceed?

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_030
25.description: Exquisite. Simply exquisite. Never have I seen such concentrations of pure aether in so lovely a frame. The life energy is palpable.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_031
26.description: Yes, with this I have all I need to infuse crystals with the energies of light and dark. Behold!

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_032
27.description: The astral and umbral energies that once dwelled within your weapon have been made manifest. Nodules of the purest aether.

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_030
28.description: Harnessing the soul energy of <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>, Syndony has crafted astral and umbral nodules.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_031
29.description: Harnessing the soul energy of <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> and <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>, Syndony has crafted astral and umbral nodules.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_032
30.description: You cannot accept the astral and umbral nodules due to insufficient inventory space.

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_000_033
31.description: You do not possess the selected Zodiac Weapon Zeta.

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_040
32.description: Ah, so you've gathered the requisite luminous crystals. Quite the hardened traveler, aren't you.

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_000_041
33.description: As you are no doubt aware, each nodule requires a different mixture of crystals. So, which would you have from me?

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_050
34.description: The luminous crystals I require are formed from aether, but in a rather unusual way. In addition to naturally occurring aether of the elements, they also absorb the residual energies of those brave souls who have long since returned to the Lifestream.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_200_050
35.description: Both the astral and umbral nodules require three types of elementally aspected luminous crystals.

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_051
36.description: As its name suggests, the astral nodule requires crystals whose energies lean toward the astral. Namely, fire, wind, and lightning. Conversely, ice, earth, and water crystals are required for the umbral nodule.

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_TALK_100_052
37.description: The process demands a great deal of aether. Without at least one of each element, I cannot guarantee it will work.

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_100_053
38.description: You may acquire the astral and umbral nodules in exchange for elementally aspected luminous crystals. These crystals may be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs in certain areas.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_100_054
39.description: Luminous wind crystals may be obtained from FATEs in the Sea of Clouds.<hex:02100103>Luminous fire crystals may be obtained from FATEs in Azys Lla.<hex:02100103>Luminous lightning crystals may be obtained from FATEs in the Churning Mists.

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_100_055
40.description: Luminous ice crystals may be obtained from FATEs in the Coerthas western highlands.<hex:02100103>Luminous earth crystals may be obtained from FATEs in the Dravanian forelands.<hex:02100103>Luminous water crystals may be obtained from FATEs in the Dravanian hinterlands.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEF2ANIMAWEAPON010TRADE_00324_SYSTEM_100_056
41.description: Luminous crystals may be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs in the aforementioned regions with any Disciple of War or Magic, regardless of level.
